results.controlIntent: a. Conduct a risk assessment, including: 1. Identifying threats to and vulnerabilities in the system; 2. Determining the likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction of the system, the information it processes, stores, or transmits, and any related information; and 3. Determining the likelihood and impact of adverse effects on individuals arising from the processing of personally identifiable information; b. Integrate risk assessment results and risk management decisions from the organization and mission or business process perspectives with system-level risk assessments; c. Document risk assessment results in [Selection: security and privacy plans; risk assessment report; [Assignment: organization-defined document]]; d. Review risk assessment results [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; e. Disseminate risk assessment results to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]; and f. Update the risk assessment [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or when there are significant changes to the system, its environment of operation, or other conditions that may impact the security or privacy state of the system.

judgment.rationale: The only available evidence collector — getModelCard — returned null for model "churn-predictor-v1" (endpoint: "churn-predictor-endpoint"). This means no model card exists for this model. A model card is the primary artifact expected to document risk assessment results, including: (a) identified threats and vulnerabilities, likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access/use/disclosure, and adverse effects on individuals from PII processing; (b) integration of organizational risk management decisions; (c) documented risk assessment results; (d) review cadence; (e) dissemination to relevant personnel; and (f) update frequency tied to significant system changes. With no model card present, there is no evidence that any of these RA-3 sub-requirements have been addressed. The control is not satisfied.
gaps: No model card exists for churn-predictor-v1 — the getModelCard collector returned null. The following evidence would be needed to satisfy RA-3: (1) Documentation of identified threats and vulnerabilities to the system; (2) Likelihood and magnitude of harm analysis from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction; (3) Analysis of adverse effects on individuals from PII processing; (4) Evidence that risk assessment results are integrated with organizational/mission-level risk management decisions; (5) A risk assessment report or equivalent documented artifact; (6) A defined review frequency and evidence of periodic reviews; (7) Evidence of dissemination to defined personnel or roles; (8) A defined update frequency and evidence of updates upon significant system changes. Human attestation or alternative documentation (e.g., a separate risk assessment report, security plan, or privacy impact assessment) would be required to close these gaps.
